summary.headline: Moon and Saturn Significations
summary.text: Astrological significations of the Moon and Saturn in nativities, including social roles, body parts, substances, colors, tastes, sects, diseases, misfortunes, and violent deaths. The apparatus identifies readings from Rhetorius, Boll, and Kroll and explains Cancer as the Moon’s domicile.
